basic_info.description: Welcome to 1459 22nd Ave, a gorgeous 5 bedroom 3 bath 2251 square feet remodeled home in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Sunset neighborhood. Thoughtfully designed for modern living, this spacious residence offers 3 bedrooms and 2 baths on the main floor, creating an ideal layout for convenience and comfort. The open layout enhances the flow between the living room with fireplace, dining room, and the kitchen, perfect for gatherings and everyday living. The chef's kitchen includes a 48 Viking stove and island with seating. The lower level features 2 additional bedrooms, 1 bath, and a family room with a wet bar and sliding doors that open to the backyard, offering a seamless connection to outdoor living and entertainment spaces. Level yard with stamped concrete, grassy area and a play set. New modern luxury vinyl floors on the first floor, fresh interior paint throughout, providing a bright and contemporary feel. Property was meticulously maintained by owner with new windows, sliding door, new fence and sewer lateral in 2010. Located a short stroll to Golden Gate Park, top schools, UCSF, local restaurants, shops & public transportation. With its combination of style, space, and functionality, 1459 22nd Ave is a perfect place to call home.
